summary: Practise ESF risk assessment, ESCP planning, stakeholder engagement and monitoring. Explore the five-day course and strengthen project follow-through.
lede: World Bank Environmental and Social Framework training helps practitioners assess project risks and link applicable standards to project commitments. For intermediate environmental and social specialists, project officers and managers, it develops practical skills in ESS applicability screening, risk classification, applying the mitigation hierarchy and assigning actions in an Environmental and Social Commitment Plan. Participants also practise recording stakeholder feedback, updating commitments after project changes and following monitoring findings through corrective action.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for intermediate practitioners who assess or oversee environmental and social risks, plans, consultations, monitoring and reporting on World Bank-financed projects.
audience: Project Implementation Unit Environmental and Social Officers
prerequisites: Intermediate-level experience in environmental and social project work is expected. No coding or programming is required.
